text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original tiny animated red-panda bakery companion voice. A light high feminine cartoon soprano, small fluffy rounded resonance, sweet honeyed vowels and a soft smiling bounce. Warm, cuddly and gently mischievous, like a little storybook bakery helper. Clear short conversational phrases with playful lilting ends. Avoid mature woman narration, low mezzo resonance, breathy whispering, shrill squealing or singing.
